thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: org=bluepine spike in token QPS and 95th pct latency > 1.2s across prod-us-east (alerts: RL-ERR-73, LAT-95-8). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/9a3/bluepine - paging oncall

alex: I'm up. I can see a 4x jump in sustained concurrent streams for bluepine starting 2026-03-15T02:14Z. 50% of requests are > 1024 tokens. Spike correlated with a new customer job type (bulk-embeds).

sofia: oncall here, joining. Are we seeing token billing burn or just throttles?

alex: Both. Rate limit counters for org 8472 (bluepine) show RL rejects increasing; CPU on dedicated pool dp-02 spiked, some backpressure to hosted routes.

manny: tagging in infra. Quick check: autoscale didn't kick on those dedicated nodes due to instance warmup policy. We can either emergency-bump RL or trigger burst capacity.

sofia: Priority: minimize customer impact but avoid cluster OOM. I'm leaning emergency RL bump + disable highest-cost feature for this org (streaming attachments).

alex: Agreed. Proposed mitigations (in order):
1) Temporary org-level rate limit increase x3 for 20m (to buy time)
2) Apply traffic shaping to cap concurrent streams to 200 for bluepine
3) Disable streaming attachments feature flag for bluepine for 30m
4) Watch error_rate/latency, if still high move traffic to fallback model (quantized smaller model)

sofia: I'll run the RL bump now. Command in admin runbook:

```
# internal admin (run as oncall)
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/orgs/bluepine/actions -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"action":"update_rate_limit","payload":{"org":"bluepine","multiplier":3,"duration_minutes":20}}'
```

ops-bot: Executing action: update_rate_limit for org=bluepine by user=sofia. Request id= req_9f8c.

ops-bot: Action result: success. New temporary rate multiplier=3 (expires 2026-03-15T02:34Z). Applied at edge gateways and request routers.

alex: Confirming counters: RL rejects dropping now, qps for bluepine increased to allowed threshold, latency immediate tail improved ~18%.

manny: I've queued a short-lived node spin-up (burst capacity) for dp-02 as backup. ETA ~6m.

sofia: Next step: disable streaming attachments feature for bluepine. Command:

```
POST https://flags.internal.redwood/api/flags/feature_toggle
Body: {"org":"bluepine","feature":"streaming_attachments","enabled":false,"until":"2026-03-15T02:45Z"}
```

ops-bot: Feature toggle confirmed: streaming_attachments disabled for bluepine.

dylan: CS update: I've messaged Bluepine account team (ch: #cs-bluepine) explaining we applied a temporary rate bump and disabled streaming attachments to stabilize latency. They acknowledged and asked for ETA on full restore.

alex: Also enabled a traffic shaping rule at the edge to cap concurrent request slots to 200 for org. Rule id=ts-4492.

sofia: Monitoring: keep eye on 95th, p99 and rate rejects. If p99 doesn't drop under 2s in 10m, flip fallback model for org to smaller quantized model (model-id: rdx-small-quant). Command below if needed.

```
# fallback deploy (only if required)
POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/orgs/bluepine/actions
-d '{"action":"route_to_model","payload":{"org":"bluepine","model":"rdx-small-quant","duration_minutes":30}}'
```

manny: Burst nodes are coming up, dp-02 showing 3 new instances initializing.

ops-bot: Metric update (autosummary): RL rejects down 67%, avg latency down 22%, error_rate stable.

alex: Good progress. Two small follow-ups: 1) add temporary quota note to billing so customer's usage isn't double-billed for the bump, 2) add incident annotation so we can roll back cleanly.

sofia: I'll open a short incident tracking ticket and annotate runbook. Ticket: INC-2026-1492.

customer-success: PS: Bluepine is on a tight job run schedule; they asked to be notified 10m before rollback. I'll relay.

dylan: Noted. I'll schedule the 10m pre-rollback alert and ping them.

sofia: Current status: RL bump active, streaming attachments disabled, traffic shaping in place, burst nodes initializing. Metrics trending good. I'm leaving oncall to follow remediation and will handoff to alex at 02:34Z when RL expires unless we extend.

alex: I'll pick up at 02:34Z. If we need to extend, we'll keep increments of 10m and coordinate with CS. Also update runbook with exact commands used.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: @alex, RL bump expiry at 2026-03-15T02:34Z (req_9f8c).

sofia: Handoff: I'm clear. Handoff notes: temp RL x3 for 20m, streaming attachments disabled until 02:45Z, traffic shape cap 200, burst nodes coming. Ticket INC-2026-1492 includes links + runbook snippet.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll monitor and either let it expire or extend. Great coordination :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation applied, customer impact reduced). Please update postmortem if any follow-up (billing credits, runbook improvements).
